b5007137a6.q: How many national championships has Phil Ramsey won across different sports?
b5007137a6.a: Phil Ramsey has won three national championships: a college football championship at Northwestern College NAIA Division II, a men's flag football national championship, and a senior softball world championship in Las Vegas when he was 74 years old. He also won state championships in flag football with the North Central team.

cf38500678.q: What was Phil Ramsey's most memorable national championship victory?
cf38500678.a: His most memorable championship was at Northwestern College Division II NAIA when his team won after being runners-up the previous year. The coach said they would come back and win, then drove them hard in training. They went undefeated and beat South Dakota State that year. When they drove back from the championship, there were cars lined up all the way from Lamar's to Orange City celebrating, making it the first national championship for that area.

405785aa1c.q: Why did Phil Ramsey attend college when he initially opposed the idea?
405785aa1c.a: Phil Ramsey initially rejected college as a waste of time and money, but after his draft lottery number came up as four during the Vietnam War era, making him certain to be deployed, he prayed asking God for an alternative. A friend's mother who worked at Frankel's Clothing helped pull strings to get him one of the last available 2-S student deferments that year, allowing him to attend Northwestern College instead of going to Vietnam.

c1f0af0273.q: What impact did Ron and Sharon Stubbs have on Phil Ramsey's faith and leadership?
c1f0af0273.a: Ron and Sharon Stubbs were youth group leaders who took Phil and other young people to their home every Sunday night, feeding them and providing activities like basketball and ping pong. They prepared the group for mission trips to Mexico and later took them to a lake home on the Ozarks to water ski and reflect. Phil credits their leadership with shaping his approach to try to be successful in all he does while putting Christ first.

bf36a86a21.q: How did Phil Ramsey's competitiveness philosophy apply to flag football games at Anamosa Prison?
bf36a86a21.a: Phil played with a flag football team made up of former college players that visited Anamosa Prison, where inmates had their own team wearing Iowa Hawkeye uniforms. The prisoners bet big money against the outside team the first year, expecting to lose by 30 points but were instead humiliated 60-something to 4 or 6. The next year, the same inmates bet heavily on Phil's team to win by 55 points, and the team again dominated despite physical play from the prison team.
